name: id
description: OpenFEMA record id (stable, unique per policy term). Used to generate the fictional policy number / name.

name: propertyState
description: 2-letter state of the insured property.

name: reportedCity
description: City as reported. Usually redacted by FEMA ('NA').

name: reportedZipCode
description: 5-digit ZIP code of the insured property.

name: censusGeoid
description: Census block group GEOID.

name: nfipCommunityName
description: NFIP community name, e.g. 'HOUSTON, CITY OF'.

name: nfipRatedCommunityNumber
description: NFIP community number used for rating.

name: latitude
description: Approximate latitude (rounded by FEMA for privacy).

name: longitude
description: Approximate longitude (rounded by FEMA for privacy).

name: ratedFloodZone
description: Flood zone used to rate the policy (AE, X, VE...).

name: policyEffectiveDate
description: ISO-8601 timestamp text, e.g. 2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z. Parsed to DATE in SQL.

name: policyTerminationDate
description: ISO-8601 timestamp text. Parsed to DATE in SQL.

name: cancellationDateOfFloodPolicy
description: ISO-8601 timestamp text; NULL if not cancelled.

name: originalNBDate
description: Original new-business date (ISO-8601 text).

name: totalBuildingInsuranceCoverage
description: Building coverage limit, USD.

name: totalContentsInsuranceCoverage
description: Contents coverage limit, USD.

name: buildingDeductibleCode
description: Coded building deductible (see data_pipeline/nfip_codes.py).

name: contentsDeductibleCode
description: Coded contents deductible (see data_pipeline/nfip_codes.py).

name: primaryResidenceIndicator
description: True if the insured building is the primary residence.

name: occupancyType
description: Occupancy code (1/11 single family, 2/12 2-4 units, ...).

name: policyCount
description: Number of policies represented by the row (usually 1).

name: policyTermIndicator
description: Policy term code (1 = one year).

name: condominiumCoverageTypeCode
description: Condo coverage type code (N = not a condo policy).

name: rentalPropertyIndicator
description: True if the property is rented out.

name: tenantIndicator
description: True if the policyholder is a tenant.

name: asOfDate
description: Date FEMA last refreshed this record (ISO-8601 text).
